# SYNTHETIC (v1b-27): not recorded. Built from the real 2.1.310 edit frames' layout (claude-edit-prompt/) and the
# 2.1.310 bundle's Write prompt: titles "Create file"/"Overwrite file", "Do you want to create|overwrite <name>?",
# overwrite as an old->new diff with 3 context lines. The real create view is a plain code listing whose gutter
# is unconfirmed; this frame uses the edit diff gutter. Content: create b.txt "hello\nworld"; overwrite a.txt
# "alpha\nbeta\ngamma" -> "alpha\nBETA\ngamma".
=== create
⏺ Write(b.txt)

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 Create file
 b.txt
